---

https://openscapes.org/events

Technical details for publishing to our website are in [website wiki](https://github.com/Openscapes/website-new/wiki). We have a template [blog/blog-post-template-2025-09](https://github.com/Openscapes/website-new/tree/main/blog/blog-post-template-2025-09) that can be copied and edited for a blog or event post. 

We make event pages for Champions Cohorts, Community Calls, and other Openscapes programs ([Reflections](https://openscapes.org/events#category=reflections), Pathways), Hackdays, Unconfs, conferences or workshops we're presenting at.

- [ ] provide event text, speakers list, etc in a comment in this issue
- [ ] date in yaml is date of the event
- [ ] add categories to yaml: event; plus others like nasa-framework, noaa-fisheries, community-call, conference etc
- [ ] choose image
    - Reflections uses same image from Elliot Lowndes each time
    - Champions programs use partner logo plus Openscapes logo if possible
- [ ] publish and share in Slacks and other channels as appropriate e.g. NOAA Fisheries Google Spaces.

Post-event
- [ ] is there a blog post and /or recording associated with the event? Link to them.
- [ ] close this issue
